limitations: Local save logic is not a server-authoritative payment or anti-tampering system.
Rush receipt deduplication covers the most recent 64 completions; the UI must issue one unique ID per run.
The caller must persist the initial garden and each successful state transition.
This suite verifies domain behavior; browser rendering and storage integration need separate checks.

results.name: Browser UMD and CommonJS expose the same public API
Six beds match the existing earned flower catalog without changing its unlocks
Only an absent garden receives starter seeds; serialization cannot refill a spent balance
Malformed fields normalize to bounded safe values, ignoring inherited and unknown properties
All six beds are immediately selectable and the first shoots cost exactly four seeds
Purchases are atomic, immutable, and fail without any partial progress
Each bed reaches full bloom after exactly 26 seeds and cannot be over-upgraded
A decent Rush run awards eight seeds; weak positive runs still award one
Rush reward formula is deterministic over small runs and caps at forty seeds
Incomplete, missing-ID, malformed, and unknown-mode results cannot award or consume receipts
Duplicate completion IDs are idempotent across modes and edited reward payloads
Receipt history keeps the latest sixty-four unique completions
Campaign first clears award eight plus star quality, then only two seeds per improved star
Immediate three stars and improvement from one to three earn equal lifetime seeds
Existing campaign stars form the reward baseline without resetting unrelated progress
Campaign replay resistance remains after its run receipt has aged out
Grant, select, normalize, and summary never mutate caller-owned state or reward objects
Summary provides affordable next actions and selection without side effects
Balance saturation never wraps and reports only seeds actually added
Moon rewards stay separate from Meadow records and survive normalization and receipt aging
